why.heading: Honesty is our only capital
why.text: S M Milon Gazi oversees every project himself. He never touches land with family disputes or paperwork problems, and he hands over the flat on the date written in the contract.
why.quote: What is written on paper is what will be done. No tricks.

items.title: Dispute-free land
items.text: We never build on land with family disputes or court cases. Work does not start until the papers are clean.

items.title: Quality materials
items.text: From rods, cement and bricks to fittings, everything is bought from good brands. We never cut quality to save cost.

items.title: Handover as promised
items.text: The flat is handed over by the date written in the deed. Our past buyers are the proof.

items.title: Every update on WhatsApp
items.text: How far the work has come and any problems along the way are shared regularly in the buyers' group and in meetings.

items.title: Transparent dealings
items.text: You keep the receipt and account of every installment. No hidden charges.

items.title: Affordable installments
items.text: A small down payment and long 2 to 7 year installments, so you can pay from your salary.

services.heading: Two options to fit your budget
services.text: Not everyone can buy land and build a house. So we made a way to start with a small amount.

installment.title: Land share + flat on installments
installment.text: A small amount up front, then regular installments. Your share of the land is in your name while construction is still going on.

ready.title: Ready flats
ready.text: Don't want to wait? See a finished flat with your own eyes and buy it if you like it.

steps.title: Site visit
steps.text: Visit our office or give us a call. We'll show you around the project, and you can check the papers too.

steps.title: Booking & contract
steps.text: Pay the down payment and sign the contract. The handover date is written in the deed.

steps.title: Monthly installments
steps.text: Pay each month and get a receipt. You'll get work updates in the WhatsApp group.

steps.title: Key handover
steps.text: Take over your flat on the agreed date. We stay by your side for registration too.

emi.heading: See what you'd pay each month, right now
emi.text: Enter the flat price, your down payment and how many years you want to pay over. Your estimated monthly installment appears instantly.

tips.title: Rent vs installment
tips.text: Add a little to what you already pay in rent, and the flat becomes yours.

tips.title: Earn from rent
tips.text: Rental demand in the area is high, so renting the flat out can cover the installments.

faq.heading: What everyone asks
faq.text: Don't see your question? Call us directly, we're happy to answer.
faq.help_text: Ask us directly and we'll answer.
faq.help_message: Hello, I have a question about a flat.

items.q: How much do I need to book a flat?
items.a: Depending on the location and project, a one-time down payment of Tk 10 to 15 lakh is needed at the start. The rest is paid in monthly installments.

items.q: How much is the monthly installment?
items.a: Usually Tk 50 thousand to 1 lakh a month, depending on how many years you pay over. You can see an estimate with the calculator above.

items.q: When will I get the flat?
items.a: Within 2, 3, 5 or 7 years depending on the plan. The handover date is written in the contract, and the flat is handed over within that time.
Along with the flat you buy, a proportional share of the building's land is also in your name. So you own not just the flat but the land too.
Flats of 1000 to 1850 sq ft cost between Tk 35 lakh and 70 lakh. The price depends on size, floor and project. You can buy in full or in installments.

items.q: Can I see the land papers?
items.a: Of course. All papers, including the deed, khatian and mutation, are shown before booking. You can also have them checked by your own lawyer.

items.q: How will I get construction updates?
items.a: Each project has a WhatsApp group for its buyers, where photos and news of the work are shared. Meetings with everyone are held when needed.

items.q: What if I'm late with an installment?
items.a: Talk to our office if that happens. We try to understand the reason and find a solution. The detailed rules are in the contract.
